verdict.rationale: Meilisearch Cloud advertises read high availability through native clusterization, and a community report confirms a replicated/distributed version exists outside the free tier. One self-hoster also reports running ~80M documents on a single 64GB box. However, the evidence holds no documented guide to clustering, replication setup, sharding or horizontal scaling, and self-hosting docs describe a single binary deployment. missing for 10: documented self-hosted clustering/replication procedures, write HA or sharding/horizontal-scale guidance, evidence of a documented path to hundreds of millions of documents, independent corroboration of the Cloud HA claim.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, documented scaling paths — clustering, replication, high availability — carry me from prototype to hundreds of millions of documents

citations.quote: Guarantees the Read High Availability of the service with native support for clusterization.
A self-hoster runs ~80M documents (191GB, 13 indexes) on a 64GB Hetzner box
